attorneys: Mr. Sidney R. Prince, with whom Messrs. H. O’B. Cooper, F- G. Tompkins, L. E. Jeffries, and H. E. DePass were on the brief, for petitioners., Mr. C. Erskine Daniel, with whom Messrs. I. C. Daniel and Horace L. Bomar were on the brief, for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Reversed on the authority of Davis v. Green, 260 U. S. 349; St. Louis-San Francisco Ry. v. Mills, 271 U. S. 344; Atlantic Coast Line v. Southwell, 275 U. S. 64; and cause remanded for further proceedings.
